content.short: PXP is an enterprise payment platform processing over €30B in volume, now including stablecoins.
content.description: PXP Financial is a global payment platform for enterprise merchants, unifying payment processing, acquiring and FX, and handling more than €30 billion in volume. Stable's official ecosystem page lists PXP among its payments and FX partners.
content.meta: PXP Financial is an enterprise payments platform with €30B+ volume, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
